item.title: Two killed in multi-car crash in Everett, WA; police investigating
item.description: Police are investigating a crash that killed two people and left three others injured in Everett on Friday.

item.title: Seattle Seahawks not expecting Tory Horton to return this season
item.description: The Seattle Seahawks are not expecting wide receiver Tory Horton to return to action this season due to a shin injury that's kept him on injured reserve since early November.

item.title: Barrier-breaking Justice Mary Yu retires from WA Supreme Court
item.description: Justice Mary Yu retired after a trailblazing career, reflecting on landmark cases, the first same-sex marriage and her hopes for civility.

item.title: Man shot, killed by police in Everett, WA after multi-county crime spree
item.description: A man was shot and killed by law enforcement in Everett after a multi-county crime spree, including a kidnapping, carjacking, and brief shootout with police.

item.title: Seattle Kraken forwards Eeli Tolvanen, Kaapo Kakko to play for Team Finland at 2026 Winter Olympics
item.description: Seattle Kraken forwards Eeli Tolvanen and Kaapo Kakko were named to Team Finland for the 2026 Winter Olympics in Milano Cortina, Italy.

item.title: 'Seattle News Weekly': WA flood conspiracy theories, traditions for the new year
item.description: On this week's episode of the "Seattle News Weekly" podcast, FOX 13 Seattle's David Rose and Lauren Donovan talk about the conspiracy theories surrounding WA flooding.

item.title: Revelers pack Seattle light rail stations for NYE. Is the World Cup next?
item.description: After ringing in the New Year, thousands of people packed into Seattle light rail stations, some waiting shoulder to shoulder just to get a ride.

item.title: Seattle Seahawks, San Francisco 49ers to meet with top-seed in NFC one the line
item.description: The Seahawks and 49ers will square off Saturday night in a rare regular-season game with the top-seed in the NFC playoffs, first-round bye and home-field advantage on the line.

item.title: Children located after custodial interference in Renton
item.description: Lakewood police say two children have been reunited with their legal guardian following a custodial interference investigation involving their biological mother.

item.title: Seattle Weather: Mild, breezy at times, and scattered showers this weekend
item.description: Temperatures this weekend will be mild, reaching the mid to low 50s Saturday and Sunday with scattered showers.
